newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy telecoms draft law moves to Senate on May 13.
newsitem.headline: Italy telecoms draft law moves to Senate on May 13.

text.p: Italy's Senate will start the examination of a draft law covering the telecommunications and television industry on May 13, Italy's Post Ministry undersecretary Michele Lauria said on Tuesday.
The draft law, drawn up by Post Minister Antonio Maccanico, is aimed at reforming the telecoms and television sectors, and setting up a watchdog authority to oversee the industry.
Lauria speaking to reporters while attending a conference said the full Senate would start examining the draft law on May 13, but this did not signal a change in the government's plans.
Last December, TV licences for TV group Mediaset were extended to the end of May to give further time for the new draft law to pass through parliament.
